typedef long long ll;

const int MAXV = 250001;
const int MAXD = 250006;

int n, k, mod;
int fact[MAXV], invv[MAXV], ifact[MAXV];
int dp[MAXD][27];

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> k >> mod;

    invv[1] = fact[0] = fact[1] = ifact[0] = ifact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < MAXV; ++i) {
        invv[i] = (ll)(mod / i) * (mod - invv[mod % i]) % mod;
        fact[i] = (ll)fact[i - 1] * i % mod;
        ifact[i] = (ll)ifact[i - 1] * invv[i] % mod;
    }

    ll ans = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        ans = ans * k % mod;

    if ((n & 1) == 0) {
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if ((n & i) != i) continue;
            int msk = i - (i & -i);
            for (int j = msk;; j = (j - 1) & msk) {
                int lim = min(k - 1, __builtin_popcount(j));
                for (int t = 0; t <= lim; ++t) {
                    dp[i][t + 1] = (dp[i][t + 1] + (ll)dp[j][t] * ifact[i - j]) % mod;
                }
                if (j == 0) break;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            ll term = (ll)dp[n][i] * fact[n] % mod * fact[k] % mod * ifact[k - i] % mod;
            ans = (ans - term) % mod;
        }
    }

    cout << (ans + mod) % mod << '\n';
    return 0;
